title: Google::Auth versions 0.12 for Perl allow server side request forgery via unvalidated… (CVE-2026-74759)
description: Google::Auth version 0.12 for Perl contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability due to unvalidated URLs in AWS external account credentials. The vulnerability arises because the credential_source URLs used by the AWS external account credentials are not properly host-checked, allowing crafted configurations to cause requests to arbitrary hosts, including internal services and metadata endpoints.
